candidate_sentence_map.S1: The group delivered record financial performance in 2024, reporting a net profit of EUR 150.3 million, an increase of 7 percent compared to the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: This improvement was driven by robust top-line growth, with total net income reaching EUR 338.3 million, an 11 percent rise.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Net interest income grew by 8 percent to EUR 273.3 million, while net fee and commission income surged by 24 percent to EUR 60.3 million, reflecting heightened customer activity and broader service adoption.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Operating expenses rose by 14 percent to EUR 146.9 million, primarily due to workforce expansion, resulting in a cost-to-income ratio of 43.4 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Balance sheet expansion was substantial, with total assets growing 23 percent to EUR 8.7 billion.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The loan portfolio increased by EUR 990 million, or 28 percent, to EUR 4.6 billion, supported by strong corporate lending and retail mortgage growth.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Deposit funding expanded by 21 percent to EUR 6.9 billion, bolstered by higher interest rates attracting term deposits and successful customer acquisition that added 38,000 clients.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Credit quality remained resilient throughout the year, with non-performing loans maintaining historically low levels despite a contracting domestic economy.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Strategic developments significantly shaped the results.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The UK subsidiary capitalized on its full year of independent operations, expanding deposits by 195 percent and loans by 338 percent before launching retail services in the fourth quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: In Estonia, the group captured market share across corporate and private segments, acquiring a highly profitable loan book along the way.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: These volume gains, combined with sustained elevated base interest rates, underpinned the record operating profit.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Management notes that interest rates peaked in early 2024 before entering a rapid decline in the second half, which will pressure future net interest margins.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: To mitigate this cyclical shift, the group implemented structural cost controls, departmental restructuring, and enhanced automation, updating its financial plan mid-year to reflect 25 percent higher profitability targets.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Regulatory capital ratios remained well above minimum requirements, supported by internal earnings generation and strategic bond issuances.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Overall, the reporting period was characterized by aggressive scale expansion and solid profitability, positioning the group to navigate an easing monetary environment through disciplined cost management and continued cross-border business growth.
